protocol.repair_note: Two fail-closed numerical attempts showed that the absolute native fused-SDPA versus explicit-softmax context maximum is a cross-kernel diagnostic, not an intervention reconstruction: every intervention is the explicit updated-minus-source delta added to the exact native source. Gate that closed delta path, retain the cross-kernel maximum descriptively, and accumulate KL in fp64 with its theoretical non-negative bound.
protocol.probes: frozen Level 6.19 Memory and context probes
protocol.primary_population: source errors whose frozen Memory probe is correct

registered_budget.reference: per-example, per-head KL induced by Probe top4 4x odds, capped to a common direction-reachable ceiling
registered_budget.l2_reference: per-example context L2 induced by Probe top4 4x odds

conditions.probe_top4_odds4: FP32 analytic delta for the Level 6.19.1 intervention
conditions.gradient_top4_odds4: per-head top-four attention-logit gradients at 4x odds
conditions.gradient_kl_oracle: exponential tilt maximizing first-order deployed margin at matched per-head KL
conditions.gradient_l2_oracle: gradient exponential tilt matched to Probe top4 context L2
conditions.tangent_context_control: projection of context gradient into frozen attention value/output tangent span at matched L2
conditions.unrestricted_context_control: full context gradient at matched L2

primary_gradient_kl_family: gradient KL oracle versus Probe top4
gradient KL oracle versus negative-gradient KL
gradient KL oracle versus rolled-gradient KL
protocol.multiplicity: Holm across the four primary deployed-margin contrasts

decision_rule.specificity: all four estimates positive with Holm p < 0.05
decision_rule.positive_control: unrestricted matched-L2 context margin gain positive at p < 0.05

protocol.interpretation: all oracle conditions use labels and are mechanistic, not deployable

numerical_audit.interpretable_decomposition: native autocast Q/K/V projections followed by explicit FP32 QK softmax and value/output composition
numerical_audit.native_projection_replay: diagnostic only; distinct CUDA attention kernels are not required to be bitwise-equivalent
numerical_audit.fp32_vs_deployed_context: reported descriptively; not a gate because the absolute explicit context is never substituted into deployment
numerical_audit.closed_loop_gate: zero delta exactly reproduces deployed source; explicit updated-minus-explicit-source delta is added to that source
